title: Review of c53's fed-vortex selection (SIDH) on fresh seed 33 with a fresh mutation sequence: from random vorticity, kind b reaches 0.88 of the vortices against 0.42 in the identical-draw twin; births b:a 194:50 vs 30:78; purity 0.62
summary: Labkit run of the claim's world.py (eps 0.2, mut_dt 50; seed 33, frames 1500, spf 150, T=4500) and the claim's heredity.py on seed 33 with mut_seed 33 for both the favoured arm (eps 0.2) and the identical-draw neutral twin (eps 0). The first frame is an unstructured random vorticity field over the whole box; about 33 vortices form by t=189 and are all labelled a at t=300. Labkit: 35 vortices at the end, 117 persistent splits, generation 24, merge/split 0.90, 0 nucleations. heredity.py: favoured b share 0.88 over t>=3500 (31 b, 6 a at the end), births b:a 194:50, daughters agree with the parent's kind at 216/244 splits; twin b share 0.42 (10 b, 14 a), births b:a 30:78, daughters agree 88/108. 84 mutations in each arm (39 flips at mutation); flips of living vortices away from mutations 16 (favoured) and 4 (twin); median purity 0.62 and 0.70.

observations.D: rerun/seed33/FACTS.md: 117 persistent splits, max generation 24, merge/split 0.90 (reticulate)
observations.H: m_s33_e0.2.json vs m_s33_e0.json: b share 0.88 vs 0.42 (t>=3500), births b:a 194:50 vs 30:78, daughter kind agreement 89% (216/244) vs 81% (88/108)

controls_run.H: m_s33_e0.json: identical-draw neutral twin (eps 0, same seed and mut_seed 33)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed. Merge/split is 0.90, so the genealogy is reticulate and confidence in D and H is capped at medium. Vortices are label mixtures (median purity 0.62). Flips of living vortices away from mutations number 16 in the favoured arm against 4 in the twin; they are probably fusions with b vortices, so part of the sweep may come from fusion rather than birth. Births alone still favour b 194:50. The fitness effect is a written gain factor.
